return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

});

}

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const tgts = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter(t => t && t.center);

const prime = tgts[0] || null;

const S = oni.screenLive();

const E = oni.EASE;

const ctr = (t) => (t && t.center) ? t.center : { x: 0, y: 0 };

const home = caster ? { x: caster.center.x, y: caster.center.y } : { x: 0, y: 0 };

function centroid(list) {

if (!list.length) return home;

let x = 0, y = 0;

for (const t of list) { const c = ctr(t); x += c.x; y += c.y; }

o = o || {};

alpha: o.alpha == null ? 1 : o.alpha, zIndex: o.z || 95000, parent: o.parent || null });

}

async function fxBeam(url, from, to, o) {

if (!url) return null;

o = o || {};

const dist = Math.hypot(to.x - from.x, to.y - from.y);

const ang = Math.atan2(to.y - from.y, to.x - from.x);

sp.width = dist * (o.lengthScale || 1);

sp.height = dist * (o.thickness || 0.25);

const spr = oni.cloneToken(t);

const restore = oni.hideToken(t);

spr.position.set(c.x + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * amp * decay, c.y + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * amp * decay);

g.scale.set(1 + Math.sin(phase + v * Math.PI * 4) * 0.08);

} });

try { g.destroy(); } catch (e) {}

playSfx('sfxPop', 'sfxPopVol');

oni.particles({ x: to.x, y: to.y, count: cfg.popCount, color: cfg.color, size: 9,

radius: S.wLen(cfg.popRadius), life: 560, blend: PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD, parent: host });

if (target) return shakeTarget(target, cfg.shakeMs, S.wLen(cfg.shakeAmp));

}

const runs = [];

if (cfg.spread) {

// Radiate outward from the caster, and land real hits on the targets.

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.count; i++) {

const a = (i / cfg.count) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.random() * 0.3;

const R = S.wLen(cfg.radiateRadius) * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.6);

runs.push(float(home, { x: home.x + Math.cos(a) * R, y: home.y + Math.sin(a) * R }, i * 40, null));

runs.push(float(home, ctr(tgts[i]), 200 + i * cfg.staggerMs, tgts[i]));

}

} else {

const list = tgts.length ? tgts : [];

for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {

const t = ctr(list[i]);

for (let k = 0; k < cfg.count; k++) {

runs.push(float(home, t, i * cfg.staggerMs * 3 + k * cfg.staggerMs, k === 0 ? list[i] : null));

}

}

}

await wait(cfg.travelMs * 0.9);

done();

await Promise.all(runs);

if (!caster) { done(); return; }

const host = oni.layer({ zIndex: 93000 });

playSfx('sfx', 'sfxVol');

function bubble(r) {

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

g.beginFill(cfg.color, 0.28);

g.lineStyle({ width: Math.max(1, S.wLen(cfg.rimWidth)), color: cfg.rimColor, alpha: 0.85 });

g.drawCircle(0, 0, r);

g.endFill();

g.beginFill(cfg.rimColor, 0.75);

g.drawEllipse(-r * 0.33, -r * 0.36, r * 0.2, r * 0.14);

g.endFill();

return g;

}

async function float(from, to, delay, target) {

await wait(delay);

const r = S.wLen(cfg.size) * 0.5 * (1 + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * cfg.sizeJitter);

const g = bubble(r);

g.position.set(from.x, from.y);

host.addChild(g);

const perp = Math.atan2(to.y - from.y, to.x - from.x) + Math.PI / 2;

const amp = S.wLen(cfg.wobbleAmp) * (0.4 + Math.random());

const phase = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;

await oni.tween({ from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.travelMs * (0.8 + Math.random() * 0.45), ease: E.inOutQuad, onUpdate: (v) => {

const w = Math.sin(phase + v * Math.PI * 2 * cfg.wobbleHz) * amp * (1 - v * 0.4);

g.position.set(from.x + (to.x - from.x) * v + Math.cos(perp) * w,

from.y + (to.y - from.y) * v + Math.sin(perp) * w);

g.scale.set(1 + Math.sin(phase + v * Math.PI * 4) * 0.08);

} });

try { g.destroy(); } catch (e) {}

playSfx('sfxPop', 'sfxPopVol');

oni.particles({ x: to.x, y: to.y, count: cfg.popCount, color: cfg.color, size: 9,

radius: S.wLen(cfg.popRadius), life: 560, blend: PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD, parent: host });

if (target) return shakeTarget(target, cfg.shakeMs, S.wLen(cfg.shakeAmp));

}

const runs = [];

if (cfg.spread) {

// Radiate outward from the caster, and land real hits on the targets.

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.count; i++) {

const a = (i / cfg.count) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.random() * 0.3;

const R = S.wLen(cfg.radiateRadius) * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.6);

runs.push(float(home, { x: home.x + Math.cos(a) * R, y: home.y + Math.sin(a) * R }, i * 40, null));

}

for (let i = 0; i < tgts.length; i++) {

runs.push(float(home, ctr(tgts[i]), 200 + i * cfg.staggerMs, tgts[i]));

}

} else {

const list = tgts.length ? tgts : [];

for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {

const t = ctr(list[i]);

for (let k = 0; k < cfg.count; k++) {

runs.push(float(home, t, i * cfg.staggerMs * 3 + k * cfg.staggerMs, k === 0 ? list[i] : null));

}

}

}

await wait(cfg.travelMs * 0.9);

done();

await Promise.all(runs);

`;

try {

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null });

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 20000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS },

meta: { source: "Bubble Splash" },

});

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now() });

}

})();
